items.title: 5.5 Elastic deformation, plastic deformation aur elastic limit (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.5 with Fig. 5.5 and Example 5.1 (PDF 98-99).

blocks.text: Tensile test mein metal ki wire ko ek fixed speed (tezi) se kheencha jata hai, aur kheenchne ke doran wire mein paida hone wala stress machine mein lagi ek electronic device lagatar napti rehti hai. Force-elongation (force aur lambai ke increase ka) diagram ya stress-strain curve X-Y chart recorder par khud ban jata hai. Ductile material ka aam stress-strain curve Fig. 5.5 mein hai.

Deformation ke shuru mein stress strain ke saath linearly (seedhi line ki tarah) barhta hai, curve ke point A tak. Ise proportional limit (σₚ) kehte hain: woh sab se zyada stress jis tak stress aur strain ka straight line wala relation qaim rehta hai. Hooke's law kehta hai ke strain (deformation) stress (force ya load) ke seedha proportional hai; yeh law hissa OA mein lagu hota hai. A se B tak stress aur strain proportional nahi rehte.

blocks.alt: Stress (sigma) ka Strain ke muqable graph, origin O se. Curve O se A tak seedhi line mein uthta hai, B par murta hai, aahista uth kar sab se oonche point C tak jata hai aur phir D tak gir kar khatam hota hai. A, B aur C par chhote daire hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.5: Ek aam ductile material ka stress-strain curve (kitab ki Figure 5.5 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: O se A tak stress aur strain ek hi ratio mein (proportional) barhte hain (Hooke's law), is liye OA seedhi line hai. Kitab ki tasveer mein O ke qareeb line thori muri hui chhapi hai; text ke mutabiq yahan seedhi banai gayi hai. B elastic limit (yield point), C sab se zyada stress (UTS) aur D toot jane ka point hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 5.5 mein curve O ke paas muri hui chhapi hai, jabke text kehta hai ke A tak (proportional limit) stress aur strain proportional hain, yani OA seedhi line honi chahiye. Oopar OA seedhi banai gayi hai.
